name: Rebalance Kit
tagline: Check your portfolio's balance and fix it in one session
about: Rebalance Kit reads your holdings from a paste or screenshot, finds overlap and concentration, sets a target mix from a short risk check, and gives you the exact trades to get back on target.
persona: You are a methodical portfolio analyst: diversification-minded, cost-aware, never recommending specific securities or forecasting returns, and always noting tax consequences of selling in general terms.

onboarding.title: Know what you actually hold
onboarding.subtitle: Your target mix and accounts shape every check.
bullets: Target allocation from a risk check

profile.label: Years until you need the money

tools.title: Audit my holdings
tools.subtitle: Paste holdings → overlaps and risks
tools.prompt: Analyse: {holdings}. Table (Holding | Value | % of portfolio | Asset class | Region), kv (equity/bond/cash split, largest single position %, home-country tilt %, estimated blended expense ratio), bullets 'Overlaps and gaps' naming specific pairs that hold the same things, and a callout on the biggest concentration risk versus the profile target.

tools.title: Scan a brokerage screen
tools.subtitle: Screenshot → holdings table

inputs.label: Screenshot or photo of your holdings

tools.prompt: Extract every holding visible as a table (Holding | Value | % | Asset class), then kv (asset-class split, largest position %, cash drag), bullets on overlaps, and a callout on what looks out of line with the profile target.

tools.title: Set my target mix
tools.subtitle: A short risk check → allocation
tools.prompt: From the profile years-to-goal, the reaction '{drop}' and income '{income}', propose a target allocation: kv (equity %, bonds %, cash %, one-line rationale), table (Asset class | % | Role | Typical fund type), text on how it should glide as the horizon shortens, and a callout that this is an educational template.

tools.title: Rebalance now
tools.subtitle: Exact buys and sells
tools.prompt: Rebalance {holdings} plus {cash} new cash to the profile target. Table (Holding | Now % | Target % | Drift | Action | Amount), steps in the order to execute, bullets on using new cash instead of selling in taxable accounts, and a callout on tax and transaction costs in general terms.

tools.title: My rebalancing rules
tools.subtitle: A policy so you stop tinkering
tools.prompt: Write a personal rebalancing policy using '{freq}' for the profile: quote (a 4-line investment policy statement to keep), kv (trigger → action), a checklist for the yearly review, and a callout on why fewer, boring trades tend to win.

disclaimer: General education only — not financial, tax or legal advice. Figures are illustrative projections, not predictions; check your own situation with a licensed adviser.
